terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A welded galvanised barrier panel: one rigid frame on two fixed feet. Nothing opens, turns or swings on the prop itself -- the feet swivel in life but ship fixed across the run -- and the hook and eye are silhouette, not sockets, since linking is done by placing the next panel. One root pivot and zero sockets. Event fronts, temple fairs, motorcade routes, road closures; links into runs. Cloudy zinc with rust at every weld, flat bar feet scuffed pale.

reasoning: ONE tube frame -- top rail with 0.12 m rounded corners as one polyline tube, bottom rail, two uprights, five bar tubes, two foot stubs, an eye and two hooks, rust collars at the welds -- merged on one material, plus ONE component of five 3 mm sheet panels in the bays: TWO draw calls (the proxy occupancy reads the top rail at 0.92-0.98 H, the bottom rail at 0.34-0.40 H, solid infill).
One material: galvanised steel as vertex colours on white -- zinc, a paler sheet, rust-brown collars -- with a soft grime mottle canvas.
No repetition system: five sheet panels differ in width (the open bay breaks the rhythm), so they are five boxes in one merge rather than an InstancedMesh.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider on the root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is the rounded-corner tube frame with flat feet and the bay pattern the plate shows -- five sheet panels and one open bay near the +X end; the tubes are real cylinders because their round highlight is what reads galvanised at distance.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 2.00 x 1.10 x 0.45 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -1.043..+0.987: the uprights at +-0.92 with the eye reaching -1.043 and the hooks +0.987; y 0.00 to 1.10 at the top rail crown; z +-0.275 at the 0.55 m feet (declared 0.45: the feet overrun the declared depth by 0.05 m each side, and the collider is set to the declared). The proxy normalises to w:h 1:0.635 including the hooks, i.e. 1.33 H for the panel itself; the DECLARED 2.00 x 1.10 (1.82 H) is the registry contract for a standard panel and is what is built, so the band table's +0.33 H width residual is the declared aspect, not the build.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/zinc.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.860. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.region: weld collars at every bar end
localOverrides.evidence: crops/rust.png -- rust bloom at the bar-to-rail welds; carried as brown collar boxes, not as a tile.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-zinc (0.86) at #8f9394 sd 35 (cloudy zinc) and region-rail at #939391; carried at #9a9d9e on the tubes and #a4a7a8 on the sheets as vertex colours on a WHITE material; feet #8d8c87 off region-foot #7c7b75; rust collars #8a6a4a.
Metalness 0.30, not physical: the thaikit harness has no environment map and a full metal renders black.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px grime mottle canvas after construction (wash 0.74/0.72/0.68 at 0.35).
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components, no repetition system: 2 of 4.

materials.note: steel only: 1 of 3; sheet, feet and rust are vertex colours.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1,204 of 4,000: a 14-point corner-rounded tube at 10 segments, twelve short tubes, one ring lathe, seventeen boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Polyline tubes for every rail, bar and hook; a small ring lathe for the eye; boxes for the feet, the sheets and the weld collars.
No InstancedMesh: the five sheets differ in width. In a scene the HOST instances the whole panel along a run.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
The material is declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB of texture VRAM.
